edit.new: a past date (*1998*, 1979年, 1980年代) → `(document-creation-time :before s1t)` (a future one `:after`), never `root`;

edit.old: - An event in a complement clause takes its matrix event as parent; a purpose is `:after` its main event.
edit.new: - An event in a complement clause takes its matrix event as parent. A purpose event overlaps its main event: `(main :overlap purpose)`. A cause that happened earlier is `:before` its main event: `(main :before cause)`. An earlier event whose result is used (遗留下来的印刷机) is `(user :before 遗留)`, and 遗留 i...

edit.old: Never anchor it to an event of an earlier sentence unless the text explicitly sequences them (然后, after that).
edit.new: Anchor it to an event of an earlier sentence only when the sentence explicitly continues that narrative. Such a sentence is marked by 然后, 于是 or 也, or it states a result of the event just told (黑白印刷也成了该刊的特色 after the founding → `(founding :overlap 成)`).

*because* + noun phrase (由于…内容) → `:reason`; when 因为/由于 … (于是/所以) or 为(了) links two full clauses, reify it: `(h / have-reason-91 :ARG1 result :ARG2 cause :aspect state)`, `(h2 / have-purpose-91 :ARG1 main :ARG2 purpose :aspect state)` (nest them when both occur: have-reason-91 :ARG1 have-purpose-91)...

edit.text: - A sentence-initial 不过/但是 that links to the previous sentence is dropped: no `but-91` with only `:ARG2`; the clause's event is the root. Use `but-91` only when both conjuncts are in the sentence.

edit.old:
- A conceiver that is not in the text is `null-conceiver`. Purpose and condition clauses may use the
  constants `purpose` and `have-condition` as parents of their events.
edit.new: - A conceiver that is not in the text is `null-conceiver`. There are no `purpose` or `have-condition` constants: a purpose or condition event that the author asserts takes `author` as its parent.

edit.anchor: use `publication` only when the kind is unknown.
edit.text: This typing is for named entities only: an unnamed mention keeps the Chinese word (该刊 → `(k / 刊 :mod (g / 该))`). A named human in Chinese is `individual-person`, not `person`.

A V+量 noun (发行量, 销量, 产量) splits into `(l / 量 :quant-of (f / 发行-01 :ARG1 X))`, and the hidden event gets a temporal triple (overlap the clause's event). An amount reached or dropped to (达到/跌至 N 份) goes on 量 as `:ARG1-of (h / have-quant-91 :ARG2 N :unit (u / 份))`, not as an argument of the verb and n...

edit.old: - A version or part of a publication or object (X的纸本) → `:part-of`, not `:possessor`.
edit.new:
- A version, edition or format of a publication or object (X的纸本, 黑白版面的X) → the edition noun is the concept and takes `:part-of` the publication. It, not the publication, is the argument of the verb (创立/改为 … 版面): `(b / 版面 :mod (h / 黑白) :part-of (n / newspaper ...))`.
- An appositive common noun + nam...

edit.old: Do not fill a Chinese zero subject of a later clause (…仍继续发行…) by re-entrancy: leave the role out.
edit.new: Do not fill a Chinese zero subject of a later clause (…仍继续发行…) by re-entrancy: leave the role out. The same holds for the agent of a purpose clause (为充分运用… gets no added `:ARG0`) and for possessors not expressed in the text.

edit.old: even with 了 when the clause describes what the entity does in general.
edit.new: even with 了 when the clause describes what the entity does in general. This applies only to main predications. An event inside a purpose clause or relative clause is `process` (容纳 in a purpose clause) or `activity` (为充分运用 → 运用 `activity`).

Main event of a later sentence: `(document-creation-time :before s2x)`, not anchored to sentence 1, unless it continues the narrative (…也成了该刊的特色 → `(s7创立 :overlap s8成)`).
